notes: C17 responsive dual-render: every real posting anchor lives inside a mobile-only md:hidden block, while the desktop rendition of the same posting is non-anchor divs with the click handler bound through React. At the runtime viewport the visibility gate correctly drops the whole anchored rendition, so the matcher sees 0 without hooks.pre_extract_css and 217 (all locations) with it. job_board_url is the ?l=Costa+Rica pre-filter: the Locations filter IS URL-addressable, but its control is a readonly sr-only checkbox behind a styled span, which the native-select filter census does not see; hooks.filter_already_applied=True guards the pre-filter against agent re-toggle. suppress_ancestor_selector='a[href^="#"]' drops fragment-only in-page anchors (#, #main-content, #grnhse_app): once the page URL carries a query string they collapse to the board URL itself after fragment stripping and land in the id-in-query bucket alongside the real postings. expected_unfiltered_count=7 therefore equals expected_jobs because the URL baseline IS the filtered view.
